verdict.summary: Issue #215 is materially complete as a publication-hardening contract, but execution remains blocked because no integration lane has authenticated owner authorization or trusted live verification.

blockingFindings.title: Integration lane lacks owner authorization and trusted live evidence
blockingFindings.details: For marius-patrik/Andromeda issue #215 at verified version bff3017cbe09c46eee07d0578ae7ef2135e26b2f6bf5d07f6e9ff73c2fdc4012, trusted state establishes only that the issue is open and the repository default branch is main. It does not authorize PR #240 or verify its base, exact head, anchor inclusion, scope correspondence, merge state, integration commit, ancestry, or exact-head required checks. The expected state is an authenticated owner decision selecting the sole integration lane and exact base/head, followed by trusted control-plane verification of every required live fact. Until then, implementation, integration, delivery, and closure remain blocked, with df:blocked and df:ask-owner retained.

nonBlockingNotes: Owner decision required: Should PR #240 remain the sole integration lane for #215, and if so which exact head and base are authorized?

Apart from the unresolved integration authority, the current contract clearly defines its goal, owned publication paths, non-goals, dependency boundary with #243, retry and atomicity invariants, failure behavior, objective validation coverage, rollout, rollback, and closure evidence.
